headline: Sunteck Realty Limited: General Updates
sum: General Updates - Sunteck Realty Limited has informed the Exchange that the wholly owned subsidiary of the Company has acquired land admeasuring approx. 4.5 acres, adjacent to New Link Road, Borivali West, Mumbai.
